# filelock

Locks the specified file. *(version 4.74 or later)*

```ttl
filelock <file handle> [<timeout>]
```

## Remarks

Locks the specified whole file for exclusive access by the calling process.
The &lt;timeout&gt; argument is described below.

<table>
 <tr>
  <th><b>&lt;timeout&gt;</b></th>
  <td><b>Description</b></td>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <th>0</th>
  <td>Returns quickly the error when the file is already locked.</td>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <th>Abbreviation</th>
  <td>Returns only when the file is unlocked.</td>
 </tr>
 <tr>
  <th>Value</th>
  <td>Waits until the file is unlocked or the time-out interval(in seconds) elapses.
      Returns the error when the time-out interval elapsed.</td>
 </tr>
</table>

If the function succeeds, the system variable "result" is set to 0.
If the function fails, the system variable "result" is set to 1.

## Examples

```ttl
fileopen fhandle 'test.txt' 0
filelock fhandle
if result!=0 then
	messagebox 'error' 'hoge'
endif
filewrite fhandle 'sample'
pause 60
fileunlock fhandle
if result!=0 then
	messagebox 'error' 'hoge'
endif
fileclose fhandle
```
